name: Google Search
layout_summary: Home page: centered Google logo and rounded search input box. Results page: search input bar at top-left, filter tabs (All, Images, Videos, News, Maps) directly below search bar, vertical list of organic blue-title result links in main column.
avoid_traps: Do NOT click the microphone ('Search by voice') or camera ('Search by image') icons inside the right end of the search box.
Do NOT click 'I'm Feeling Lucky' unless asked to jump directly to the first site.

search.verify: Google search results page loads for the query
